description: This file defines data structures and methods for generating and representing differences (diffs) between versions of blocks in a project, including handling of properties, schemas, and authors. It is part of a notification system for tracking changes in blocks within a board.

classes.name: Diff
classes.description: Represents differences between two versions of a block, including nested diffs for child blocks.

classes.name: PropDiff
classes.description: Represents a change in a property, including old and new values.

classes.name: SchemaDiff
classes.description: Represents a difference in property definitions/schema.

classes.name: diffGenerator
classes.description: A struct responsible for generating diffs between block versions, including methods for diff creation and property comparison.

methods.name: generateDiffs
methods.description: Generates diffs for a block, handling different block types and fetching historical versions.

methods.name: generateDiffsForCard
methods.description: Generates diffs for a card block, including its child blocks.

methods.name: generateDiffForBlock
methods.description: Generates a diff for a specific block, comparing current and historical versions.

methods.name: generatePropDiffs
methods.description: Compares properties of old and new blocks to identify changes.

methods.name: sortPropDiffs
methods.description: Sorts property diffs by their index.
